summary: This diagram illustrates the architecture of the Scaled Dot-Product Attention mechanism, a key component in transformer models. It shows the flow of data through linear transformations applied to the input vectors labeled as V (Value), K (Key), and Q (Query). The outputs of these linear layers are concatenated before being processed by the Scaled Dot-Product Attention block. The diagram highlights the relationships between these components, emphasizing the importance of attention in processing sequences of data.
